message.content: In the provided data, Wolfgang Schulz suggests several improvements for Li Hua's basement practice spot. One of his main suggestions involves adding sound-insulating pads to help reduce noise levels, which he proposes to be reversible and non-damaging. This aligns with Adam Smith's approval, who states that it is okay as long as these changes are reversible and do not cause any damage. Wolfgang also emphasizes the importance of keeping the changes neat and reversible, indicating his commitment to ensuring that the modifications are temporary and do not affect the overall structure of the basement.
